description: What every run has cost across a window of days, not just one run. Derived from the run folders on disk - nothing is recorded anywhere else and nothing leaves this machine. Use this to answer "what have I spent today" before starting another run. A run that paid OpenRouter also carries `providerReported`: what the provider reported beside the usd THC counted (unverified, its unit is not given, counted in no total).

days.description: how far back to look, in days. Defaults to 1.

name: spend_report
